sources: Valiant. rmxlinux SkillData sk_wpn_lance_0010: passiveEventActions abilityEvent 402 (the wielder applies a physical status) → one DamageAction atk_scale, damageType 0 (physical), decorate mask 0 with hitEnvData.inheritFirstDamageMask, no poise unit, no cooldown; SkillPatchTable atk_scale 1.2 … 3.36 (2.4 at skill level 6). Description: "After the wielder applies Physical Statuses, the wielder also deals another hit of Physical DMG equal to {atk_scale} of the wielder's ATK."
Logged as chr_0015_lifeng_ultimate_skill (fixtures/zmdlogs-4e5e1390085e.json: 5 hits at Estella's 5 Lifts, none extra at her Shatters; Lifeng isn't in the team).
The engine emits physicalStatus for Lift, Knock Down, Crush and Breach (not for Shatter or a Vulnerable-only application), which fits the log.

Skill 3's ATK +20% (cardAttributeModifier attributeType 2) and skills 1–2 (Agility, Physical DMG) are in the stat panel. buff_wpn_lance_0010 isn't created by the weapon skill (its toggleBuffs names buff_wpn_passive_spirit_01), so nothing else here.
Not known: which skill-type DMG bonus the hit takes (inheritFirstDamageMask may give it the type of the hit that applied the status); damageType none until in-game test 48.
